topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the lecture objectives and introduces the core themes of cancer evolution, cell of origin, and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer competitive advantages to drive clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tissue differentiation hierarchies and cancer stem cells dictate tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Cues and Inflammatory Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and stromal co-dependencies drive tumor initiation and maintain established malignancies.

topics.label: Analytical Methods and Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the sequencing and spatial technologies used to study tumor heterogeneity and synthesize the multifaceted evolutionary model of cancer.

topics.label: Closing Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on cancer therapy.
